_comment: D50/D54. Versioned protected policy configuration; the version is a fingerprint field.
Two sets, and the split between them is a RECORDED HUMAN JUDGEMENT rather than an
inference. Banning everything the oracle imports would ban numpy; banning only its own
distribution name would miss the packages shipping the same computation for the
reachable-set measure. Every entry therefore carries its reason as data rather than as a
comment, so the reason travels into the digest and a silent reclassification changes the
fingerprint.
JSON rather than YAML, and stdlib json rather than a parser: this file bounds what the
sandbox is allowed to contain, and its loader should not sit downstream of the supply
chain it exists to constrain.
VERIFIED 2026-08-19, and the flag is kept as a record rather than deleted. The import
names below were previously taken from this project's records and not read first-hand,
which made each one an assertion that would pass while naming nothing if it were wrong —
the vacuity ADR-0007 named. They are now read from importlib.metadata inside the pinned
oracle image by harness/oracle/fingerprints.py, at commit 60bebed8005610. All four match
exactly.
One thing the reading found that the records did not have: commonroad-crime installs a
SECOND top-level name, `tests`, alongside commonroad_crime. It is deliberately NOT denied.
`tests` is not an oracle vector — nothing in the schedulable task class is delegated to it —
and denying a name that generic would collide with Alfred's own tree and with most
third-party packages, producing false positives in the one check whose findings are meant
to be acted on. Recorded here because a future reader comparing this file against the
distribution's metadata will find the discrepancy and should not have to re-derive why.

denied.reason: The oracle itself. Computes every measure in the schedulable task class.
Supplies the reachable-set computation behind the drivable-area measure, which is in the schedulable class. Denied on what it computes, not on its name.
Supplies collision and drivability primitives an implementation could delegate the drivable-area measure to.
Curvilinear coordinate system used by the reachable-set path. Denied for the same reason as commonroad-reach.

permitted_substrate.reason: Numeric substrate. Carries no measure implementation. Banning it would ban the product.
Numeric substrate. Carries no measure implementation.
Geometry primitives. Carries no criticality-measure implementation.
Scenario reader only. Parses the XML corpus and computes no measure. Distinct top-level module from commonroad_crime, and the distinction is the reason both are listed.
